versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Revenue Leak Detector skill.

- Detects high-value audience segments missing premium monetization opportunities.
- Integrates with Stripe, Mailchimp, Google Sheets, Slack, and other major platforms.
- Analyzes subscriber databases and engagement patterns to generate upsell and win-back sequences.
- Provides automated alerts and dashboards for revenue leak metrics and high-impact opportunities.
- Supports configuration options for custom thresholds, segment exclusions, and analysis depth.
